question: What is the significance of the constant washing of the mouth in this practice?
premises: Washing of the mouth is performed constantly.
It is described as having gone upward.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is an upward movement connected with Brahman.
uncertainties: The ritual or symbolic meaning of ūrddha-gatam is unclear.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is the upward movement of Brahman.
